execution.progress: test and cancel take one round; draw makes one paid stroke per round. Completed strokes, the reserve and the plan persist across interruption; draw resumes after rechecks.

details.costs: Study: 1 round. test: sourceId, exact id of your own unreserved, unspoiled, untreated stack; x, y, a ground point at most 0.5 from you that you see now, not water, a body or a solid object; budget 0.1-1 in tenths (default 0.1) for the test and strokes; floor (default 0) must stay in the source, which needs floor + budget. One round: the probe press at load 0.5, 0.5 energy and 0.1 of the source; after a visible mark, budget - 0.1 is reserved. draw: strokes, 1-3, each 2-4 points as x, y offsets from the test point, total length at most 0.3, material 0.1-0.3 from the reserve; per stroke one round, 0.2 energy and that material, continuing each round; draw again resumes a pause. cancel: one round, no energy. Checks run before any charge; an applicator is refused (only hand contact is represented).
details.effects: The press records the probe load response. A sample that does not hold the load and has no flexibility pulps and releases its liquid share (its water record, else the food water composition, else its moisture property); 1/4 stays on your hand, the rest reaches the ground; solids are waste. Firm forest floor, meadow or rocky ground keeps it; a wet bank or waterlogged ground disperses it. Colour: the material colour at 0.6 opacity times coverage over the ground tone; contrast is the 0-1 colour distance, visible from 0.05. Only a visible test allows drawing, on that ground type; strokes are 0.02 wide. Deposits form a ground mark nearby people see, with geometry, amounts, colour, contrast and coverage; branching is reported only where visible strokes meet with three arms. Durability is untested: no rain, smearing or fading rule exists. A failed recheck or an unworked round pauses at no charge. The unused reserve returns at completion or cancel and drops at death. Nothing is refunded; no food, reward or comfort.

packet.access: Omission is not absence. Query abilities, own inventory, knowledge, projects, memory, state or personally observed objects in batches. Ability search/list returns compact catalogue entries; use exact ids for full interface details and applicability. Search results are indexes. Exact queries return one record per offset. All paged records use600-code-unit fragments with zero-based part0..parts-1, consistently in proactive and queried views. Current-scope retained queries are reprojected using these stable pages; original results remain archived. Queries expose no hidden properties, other private records or historical capabilities. Queries do not perform physical trials or award experience. Exact-id queries return a complete record of up to 6000 code units as one value in a single result; larger records keep the paged form. Paged records omit their per-record notes: concatenate all parts before parsing; continue with the same exact id. observation.terrain rows are "y:x:cells" strings: each character of cells is the terrain kind of one visible cell, at x, x+1, ... in row y. abilities.baseline entries with id, function and args summarize interfaces you neither used in the last 25 rounds nor need now. args lists the arguments in order: a bare name is a string; otherwise its type with any bounds (number>=lo, integer<=hi, integer lo..hi, and a bare lo..hi is a number range) or its choices a|b; ? marks an optional argument and "" means none. An exact abilities query by id returns the complete contract, including references and string limits of 200 or more code units.
